catalogue.title: Forest Operations Map (FOM) - Cutblocks
catalogue.publisher: Forest Science, Planning and Practices Branch

scopeAndLifecycleCaveats: The layer reflects planned operational activities for proposed and finalized, but not yet permitted, cutblocks within harvesting authorities.
PLANNED_DEVELOPMENT_DATE is an anticipated date of development, not evidence that development occurred.
Proposed cutblocks may be altered following public comments before they become final in this dataset.
This is planned-activity context, distinct from a completed-harvest record, and must not be used to infer completed harvest.
